o create a web service using.NET Framework 4.7, you can follow these steps:
1. Create a new ASP.NET Web Application project in Visual Studio.
2. Add the WebService reference to your project by right-clicking on the References folder and selecting "Add Reference" and then browsing to the System.Web.Services assembly.
3. Create a new class for your web service, for example, MyWebService.
4. Add the following using statements to your code file:
using System.Web.Services;
using System.Web.Services.Description;
using System.Web.Services.Protocols;
5. Implement the web service methods by using the WebMethod attribute. For example:
[WebMethod]
public string GetMessage()
return "Hello, World!";
6. Add the following code to the Web.config file in the root folder of your project:
<configuration>
<system.web>
<webServices>
<protocols>
<add name="HttpGet" binding="webHttpBinding" />
</protocols>
</webServices>
</system.web>
</configuration>
7. Compile and run the application. You should be able to access your web service by making HTTP GET requests to the service's URL.
Note: The above steps are just a basic example and you may need to modify them based on your specific requirements.
